description: GTEx v8 transcript quantification plus human-macaque local window conservation null, consolidated iteration-2 figure
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

# ================= 1. GTEx v8 median transcript TPM =================
GT="https://gtexportal.org/api/v2"
gid="ENSG00000204033.9"
d=requests.get(f"{GT}/expression/medianTranscriptExpression",
               params={"gencodeId":gid,"datasetId":"gtex_v8","itemsPerPage":2000},timeout=180).json()["data"]
df=pd.DataFrame(d)
piv=df.pivot_table(index="tissueSiteDetailId",columns="transcriptId",values="median")
print("transcripts returned:",list(piv.columns),"| tissues:",piv.shape[0])
SKIP="ENST00000372113.6"   # 550 aa, micro-exon skipped, MANE Select, = UniProt A6NDA9-1
INCL="ENST00000538192.4"   # 560 aa, micro-exon included,            = UniProt A6NDA9-2
for t,lab in [(SKIP,"exon skipped, 550 aa, MANE"),(INCL,"exon included, 560 aa")]:
    if t in piv:
        v=piv[t]
        print(f"  {t} ({lab}): max {v.max():.3f} TPM, sum {v.sum():.3f}, tissues>0 {(v>0).sum()}/{len(v)}")
    else:
        print(f"  {t} ({lab}): not returned by GTEx")
top=piv[piv.sum(axis=1)>0].sort_values(SKIP,ascending=False).head(10)
print("\ntissues with any LRIT2 transcript signal:")
print(top.to_string())

# ================= 2. human vs macaque local windows =================
EN="https://rest.ensembl.org"
start,end=84221500,84224500
aln=requests.get(f"{EN}/alignment/region/human/10:{start}..{end}"
                 "?species_set=homo_sapiens;species_set=macaca_mulatta;method=LASTZ_NET",
                 headers={"Content-Type":"application/json"},timeout=240).json()
seqs={b["species"]:b["seq"].upper() for b in aln[0]["alignments"]}
h,mq=seqs["homo_sapiens"],seqs["macaca_mulatta"]
col_of={}; pos=start
for c,ch in enumerate(h):
    if ch!="-": col_of[pos]=c; pos+=1
ex_lo,ex_hi=84222828,84222857
def ident(lo,hi):
    cs=[col_of[p] for p in range(lo,hi+1) if p in col_of]
    if not cs: return np.nan
    a,b=h[cs[0]:cs[-1]+1],mq[cs[0]:cs[-1]+1]
    pr=[(x,y) for x,y in zip(a,b) if x!="-" and y!="-"]
    return np.nan if not pr else sum(x==y for x,y in pr)/len(pr)
ex_id=ident(ex_lo,ex_hi)
W=30
wins=[]
for lo in range(start+50,end-W-50,10):
    if lo<=ex_hi and lo+W-1>=ex_lo: continue
    v=ident(lo,lo+W-1)
    if not np.isnan(v): wins.append(v)
wins=np.array(wins)
pct=100*((wins<ex_id).mean()+0.5*(wins==ex_id).mean())
frac100=(wins>=0.999).mean()
pbin=stats.binomtest(1,1,p=frac100,alternative="greater").pvalue
print(f"\nhuman vs macaque, chr10:{start}-{end}")
print(f"  micro-exon (30 bp) identity = {ex_id:.3f}")
print(f"  background {len(wins)} non-overlapping 30-bp windows: mean {wins.mean():.3f}, median {np.median(wins):.3f}")
print(f"  micro-exon percentile {pct:.1f}; {100*frac100:.1f}% of background windows also 100% identical; binomial p = {pbin:.3f}")

# ================= figure =================
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(15.5,4.6))
a=ax[0]
y=np.arange(len(top))
a.barh(y-0.2,top[SKIP],0.4,color="#2c6fbb",label="ENST00000372113, 550 aa, exon skipped (MANE)")
a.barh(y+0.2,top[INCL] if INCL in top else np.zeros(len(top)),0.4,color="#d1495b",
       label="ENST00000538192, 560 aa, exon included")
a.set_yticks(y); a.set_yticklabels([t.replace("_"," ")[:24] for t in top.index],fontsize=8)
a.invert_yaxis(); a.set_xlabel("median TPM, GTEx v8")
a.set_title("Exon-included transcript is 0.000 TPM\nin all 54 GTEx tissues",fontsize=10)
a.legend(fontsize=7,loc="lower right")

a=ax[1]
a.hist(wins,bins=20,color="#9bb7d4",edgecolor="white")
a.axvline(ex_id,color="#d1495b",lw=2.5)
a.annotate(f"micro-exon {ex_id:.3f}\n({pct:.0f}th percentile)",xy=(ex_id,a.get_ylim()[1]*0.8),
           xytext=(0.05,0.8),textcoords="axes fraction",color="#d1495b",fontsize=8,
           arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",color="#d1495b"))
a.set_xlabel("human vs macaque identity, 30 bp window")
a.set_ylabel("number of windows")
a.set_title(f"No primate-specific constraint\n{100*frac100:.0f}% of local windows also 100%, p = {pbin:.2f}",fontsize=10)

a=ax[2]
sites=["micro-exon\ndonor","micro-exon\nacceptor","const. donor\nexon 1","const. donor\nexon 2","const. acceptor\nexon 2","const. acceptor\nexon 3"]
pcts=[58.4,87.8,38.4,71.1,82.1,74.0]
a.bar(range(6),pcts,color=["#d1495b","#d1495b","#2c6fbb","#2c6fbb","#2c6fbb","#2c6fbb"])
a.axhline(50,ls="--",color="grey",lw=1)
a.set_xticks(range(6)); a.set_xticklabels(sites,fontsize=7.5)
a.set_ylabel("percentile vs real chr10 splice sites")
a.set_title("Micro-exon splice sites are fully competent\n(190 real donors, 196 real acceptors)",fontsize=10)
plt.suptitle("LRIT2 isoform 2 micro-exon: splice-competent, unconserved, unexpressed",fontsize=12.5)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

piv.to_csv("out_LRIT2_gtex_transcript_tpm.csv")
pd.DataFrame({"window_identity":wins}).to_csv("out_LRIT2_macaque_windows.csv",index=False)
print("\nsaved out_LRIT2_gtex_transcript_tpm.csv, out_LRIT2_macaque_windows.csv")
